title: Narde released a new single called "Where Angels Go"
htmlContent:
Los Angeles-based singer and songwriter Narde is an exceptional singer that has been consistent for a long time. She is a beautiful yet talented artist that makes magic with her music, and her intentions are pure and centered on bringing meaningful and quality music to you.

"Where Angels go" is an alternative and indie R&B song about staying true to yourself and living your life as the best version of yourself. It talks about how connections centered in truth bring out the best in you and push you closer to fulfilling your goal on earth.

"Where angels go" is an energetic and fun song that is moody but has an upbeat outline. It fills you with happy vibes, has a delightful bounce, and the fantastic rendition of Narde gave life to the song.

Narde is an exceptional artist who cares more about her song's meaning than fame, and she is one of the newest and most promising songwriters and vocalists with so much fantastic music. Her song always brings out the most profound feelings hidden in us that touch both love and self-growth. She is multi-versed in many genres that blend pop, rock, neo-soul, and so many more.

Nardes's music is ageless, and she is what you are naturally talented with so much said about this beautiful soul, we had to feature her on our page.
